ci_binding.interpretation: Hosted deterministic CI is available for a develop descendant containing the implementation and verifier repairs. The later state/protocol commit is not itself a pre-review human gate.

independent_review_summary.implementation_progress: The prior step-0 stale-hook bug is repaired; real train-case loss, checkpoint/resume, deployment loader, evaluator interface and OOF hard-negative evidence are materially stronger. SliceExtentHead topology, edema residual dilation and stock-mean injury initialization remain present.
independent_review_summary.remaining_implementation_gap: The frozen partial-H/W validity rule is not implemented: both extent loss and post-aggregation extent bias treat any slice with at least one valid H/W voxel as valid, so partial padding can contribute bias, loss and gradients. The single-versus-multi-tile proof also uses a probe-only full-context override rather than the declared canonical deployment settings.
independent_review_summary.verification_gap: The current Verifier still does not independently execute the model/runtime. Its own recorded environment has neither torch nor nnunetv2; it converts Executor-authored receipts into PASS probes. Runtime mutation results are predetermined failure payloads rather than mutations executed against the exact integrated runtime.
independent_review_summary.binding_gap: The implementation fingerprint embeds verifier fingerprint 9fbed451..., while the current frozen verifier fingerprint is 847263d0.... The runtime receipt manifest still records review_round 0. Verifier source changed after the declared integration SHA, so the current verifier fingerprint is not reproduced by the declared integration commit.

blocking_findings.finding: The Verifier still cannot independently establish the runtime claims it marks PASS. In the current receipt its own environment has torch_available=false and nnunetv2_available=false, yet it reports model-build, real-loss, checkpoint, deployment, evaluator and full-volume probes as PASS by reading Executor-authored receipts. mutation_result constructs fixed nonzero failure payloads without mutating and executing the exact model/runtime.
blocking_findings.why_it_matters: The central anti-downgrade guarantee requires an independently owned executable oracle. A defective or self-consistent Executor receipt can currently satisfy the Verifier without the Verifier observing the claimed behavior, so Planner cannot treat verifier PASS as independent evidence.
required_repair: Run the verifier-owned executable runner in an isolated verifier runtime that actually has torch, nnunetv2 and the declared train-only assets, against the exact integrated source/fingerprint.

Independently execute model construction/step0 parity, canonical total loss and gradients, mixed T2/no-T2 hooks, required final-logit interventions, checkpoint exact-resume, canonical full-volume inference, deployment load and evaluator interface instead of translating Executor JSON into PASS probes.

Implement each protected runtime mutation by actually changing or intercepting the relevant executable behavior and proving the verifier returns nonzero; do not synthesize a failure JSON from the mutation ID.
Add explicit independent tests for partial-H/W extent invalidity and for noncanonical inference context overrides.
Freeze a new verifier fingerprint only after those executable runs pass and bind it to the exact integrated source SHA.
required_regression_evidence: Verifier receipt records a runtime with torch_available=true and nnunetv2_available=true, exact integration SHA, commands, observed case hashes and independently generated outputs.
A forged Executor PASS receipt with an unchanged defective runtime fails because verifier execution disagrees.
Each runtime mutation report includes the mutation applied, command, exact mutated source/runtime fingerprint and observed nonzero verifier exit.
Removing the partial-H/W invalid-slice mask or reintroducing receipt-only replay causes verifier failure.
forbidden_workarounds: Do not treat receipt hash verification as independent runtime verification.
Do not copy Executor payload fields into verifier PASS probes.
Do not predeclare mutation failures without executing the mutation.
Do not weaken protected tests or move verifier-owned logic into Executor scope.

blocking_findings.finding: The frozen contract requires padding, all-invalid slices and partial-H/W slices to contribute zero extent bias, loss and gradient. Current code only rejects all-invalid slices. Both training and inference use a condition equivalent to valid_HxW_sum > 0, so a partially padded slice remains eligible; low wall support can also fall back to statistics over the remaining valid pixels.
blocking_findings.why_it_matters: This changes the learned slice-extent objective and deployment bias at crop/padding boundaries. It can create patch-geometry-dependent gradients and final logits, directly violating the full-case extent semantics the architecture was frozen to preserve.
required_repair: Define one shared full-H/W-valid slice mask from the valid-spatial support and use it consistently in SliceExtentHead statistics, per-slice extent loss and post-aggregation global bias.
For every partial-H/W or all-invalid output slice, force presence/area contribution, bias, supervision denominator and gradient contribution to zero.
Preserve full-case target construction and physical-bin downsampling; do not solve this by discarding valid full slices or changing target definitions.
Expose observed valid/partial/invalid slice counts and zero-contribution checks in runtime evidence.
required_regression_evidence: A deliberately partially padded H/W slice produces exactly zero scar and edema extent bias.
The same slice contributes zero to presence/area loss denominators and yields zero gradient to both extent heads.
A fully valid neighboring slice remains supervised and can affect final logits.
Verifier independently reproduces these assertions on actual model code.
forbidden_workarounds: Do not redefine partial-H/W as valid merely because one voxel is valid.
Do not mask only the final reported metric while allowing gradients or bias through.
Do not remove extent supervision or the global extent mechanism.

blocking_findings.finding: The new probe correctly uses a real train-side case and observes two output tiles, but the forced multi-tile call passes exact_context_patch_size equal to the single-window full-cover patch. Thus each tile is inferred with the full single-window context while only its output crop is aggregated. exact_context_patch_size is not part of CAREASEFullVolumeInferenceSettings and the default canonical deployment call does not use this override.
blocking_findings.why_it_matters: The near-zero single-versus-multi difference therefore proves an alternate probe path, not the declared deployment sliding-window semantics. It can hide tile-context dependence while satisfying the equality check.
required_repair: Run the forced multi-tile comparison through the same declared CAREASEFullVolumeInferenceSettings and default deployment call path used outside the probe, with a genuinely smaller patch and no hidden larger-context override.

If a larger context window is scientifically required for canonical inference, it must already be explicitly frozen in the contract/settings and used identically by deployment; do not introduce it only inside evidence generation.
Record actual patch/context settings, tile count, model forward count, aggregation path, one-time global-bias count, final-logit tolerance and decoded-label equality.
required_regression_evidence: The verifier can reproduce the comparison without supplying exact_context_patch_size or another probe-only parameter.
Changing the canonical tile patch/context behavior causes a detectable verifier failure rather than being hidden by full-volume context.
T2-present and no-T2 cases both use the same canonical settings and decoder rules.
forbidden_workarounds: Do not use full-volume context for every tile solely to force equality.
Do not add an evidence-only inference mode that differs from deployment.
Do not relax the frozen tolerance or compare only decoded labels when logits are required.

blocking_findings.finding: The active packet binds verifier fingerprint 847263d0..., but the implementation fingerprint still embeds the superseded verifier fingerprint 9fbed451.... The runtime receipt manifest still says review_round 0. Verifier source was modified on develop after the declared integration commit edb4f2..., so the active verifier fingerprint is not reproducible from that declared integration SHA.
blocking_findings.why_it_matters: Planner PASS must describe one immutable implementation+verification transaction. Mixing a newer verifier, older implementation-verifier binding and round-0 runtime manifest means a PASS cannot be replayed from the advertised SHA tuple.
required_repair: After Verifier repair/freeze, integrate that exact verifier commit and the Executor repair in declared Verifier-then-Executor order and publish a new integration SHA containing both.
Regenerate Executor evidence and implementation fingerprint against the newly frozen verifier fingerprint; remove hardcoded superseded verifier fingerprints.
Regenerate runtime receipt manifest, CI receipt and Planner packet for the next review round and exact integrated SHA. The runtime manifest review_round must match the packet/CURRENT.
Ensure all active fingerprints and receipt hashes are reproducible from the declared integration transaction; move old values only into explicit superseded provenance.
required_regression_evidence: implementation_fingerprint.verifier_fingerprint_sha256 equals CURRENT and planner packet verifier fingerprint.
runtime_receipt_manifest.review_round equals the new Planner review round and references current runtime receipts.
Checking out the declared integration SHA reproduces the verifier and implementation source hashes used by both fingerprints.
Hosted CI is bound to a descendant containing that exact integrated transaction with no later critical-source drift.
forbidden_workarounds: Do not overwrite old receipts to make hashes appear current.
Do not claim current verifier evidence against a commit that predates its source changes.
Do not leave stale round-0 manifests active while setting CURRENT audit flags to false.

nonblocking_findings.note: Executor-side step0, real total-loss denominators, canonical next-step checkpoint/resume, deployment loader, evaluator interface and OOF hard-negative receipts now contain materially stronger executed evidence. These are not re-opened as independent Executor blockers unless the repaired independent Verifier disproves them.

The prior Planner routing explicitly requested review_round 2 after repair, but the current packet still uses review_round 1. Preserve this re-entry artifact separately and increment the next published review transaction after the current repair so artifacts are not overwritten.

Freeze the repaired Verifier and integrate it.
Resume the exact production Executor and repair partial-H/W extent validity, canonical multi-tile evidence and verifier-fingerprint binding.
Integrate Verifier then Executor into a new exact integration SHA.
Regenerate current runtime manifest and fingerprints, run server-local verification and hosted deterministic CI.
Increment review_round to 2 and publish a new READY_FOR_PLANNER_REVIEW / WAITING_FOR_EXTERNAL_GPT packet.
